name: Whole Volume Distance Sampling
aliases: Monte Carlo with Whole Volume Distance Sampling
Monte Carlo with Whole Volume Distance Sampling (MCWVDS)
Whole Volume Distance Sampling — Histogram-based Transmittance Sampling, Importance Sampling for Volume Rendering
definition: A sampling strategy for path tracing or single-scattering integrators that distributes samples according to transmittance dependent on medium geometry, using a histogram of trapezoid segment integrals.
summary: Whole Volume Distance Sampling is a Monte Carlo strategy that estimates radiative transfer by distributing samples across the entire camera line segment to reduce variance in occluded areas.
